name: shift-time-input
title: Shift Time Input
description: Prevents wrong timesheets and rosters by reading 22:00–06:00 as an 8 h shift that ends the next day, asking whether 9:00–5:00 meant 5 PM (and whether 10–6 is a day or a night shift) instead of logging 20 h, questioning 0 h, over-long and 26:00-style entries, and deducting the break while catching one typed in hours, and, given the day and time zone, counts the real hours when the clocks change mid-shift (a 22:00–06:00 night is 9 h when they fall back).
